result:
I’d make **every person’s basic needs guaranteed**—food, clean water, healthcare, housing security, and education—no matter where they’re born or how much money they have.

If those fundamentals are covered, the world doesn’t magically become perfect, but a lot of the worst things—desperation, exploitation, crime driven by survival, avoidable suffering, and many kinds of conflict—get a lot less fuel. People could focus their energy on building, learning, and caring for each other instead of just getting through the day.
